Yesterday morning, while out for a walk,
I was suddenly attacked by a beggar.

I spoke to him while desperately suppressing
my fear, but he made no sense at all.
When I offered him the bone-dry bread from my pocket,
he bowed his head and thanked me—

He murmured "thank you" and knelt
down, tears streaming down his face.

With a single dry piece of bread, a
murderer became a good man in an instant.

If one dry piece of bread holds that much
power, then the meals we eat every day—

That one meal was worth how many of
those dry pieces of bread, I wonder...
